title.zh: ⚡️贝森特：美国财政部将弥合SEC与CFTC的加密监管空白
title.en: ⚡️贝森特：美国财政部将弥合SEC与CFTC的加密监管空白

current_state.zh: US Treasury Secretary Bessent said the Treasury will push to bridge the crypto regulatory gap between the SEC and CFTC regardless of whether Congress acts, signaling coordinated federal oversight even if legislation stalls.
current_state.en: US Treasury Secretary Bessent said the Treasury will push to bridge the crypto regulatory gap between the SEC and CFTC regardless of whether Congress acts, signaling coordinated federal oversight even if legislation stalls.
